paite: "Aw chiing, nang ta nei ngei lou, nuamsatak in la sa in; nang, nauvei ngei lou, la sakhe guih in, kikoukhia in; pasal neimi tate sang in lunglengnu tate lah atamzaw ngal ua," TOUPA'N achi.
heading: TOUPA'N Israel A-itna
english: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says Yahweh.

paite: Na puanin mun kek in, na omnate puanin tung kaipalh in; chil ke'n; na khaute sausak inla, na kaihgakna khette kipsak in.
english: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.

paite: Taklam leh veilam ah na dalhzak sin ngal a; huchi in na chisuante'n namte' gou aluah ding ua, khopi loih sa nungte ah mi a- omsak nawn ding uh.
english: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.

paite: "Lau ke'n, na zahlak kei ding; zum sam ke'n, zahlak in na om sin kei hi; na tuailai zahlakna na mangngilh in, na meithaina minsiatna na theigigeta kei ding hi.
english: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.

paite: Nang hon bawlpa na pasal ahi a; amin sepaihte' TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou nang hon tanpa ahi; amah leitung pumpi Pathian achi ding uh.
english: For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

paite: "Zi mak lungsim a lungkhamtak, tuailai zi khensa, paihsa nung sap nawn bang in TOUPA'N nang ahon sam ahi, na Pathian in achi hi.
english: For Yahweh has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.

paite: Mitphiat kal lel ka hon ma a; himahleh hehpihna thupitak in ka hon pi nawn ding.
english: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.

paite: Ka heh dimlet in mitphiat kal na lak ah ka mai ka sel a; himahleh tangtawn zahngaihna in ka hon hehpih ding," TOUPA nang hon Tanpa'n achi hi.
english: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says Yahweh your Redeemer.

paite: "Huai lah kei a ding in Noah dam lai nite bang ahi a; Noah tuite'n leitung atummang nawn kei ding, chi a, ka kichiam bang in, Na tung ah ka heh nawn kei ding a, ka hon sal nawn kei ding, chi in ka kichiamta ahi.
english: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.

paite: Tangte apaimang ding ua, mual neute leng suan in a-om ding uh; ka zahngaihna ahihleh nang a kipan in apaimang kei ding a, ka lemna thukhun leng suan in a-om sam kei ding," TOUPA hon hehpihpa'n achi hi.
english: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.

paite: "Aw nang hihgentheih, tuikihot sepsep, lungmuanna nei lou, ngai in na suangte zehoih in ka lem ding, na suangphumte sapphir suang in ka lem ding hi.
heading: Tunung Jerusalem
english: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.

paite: Na tungzumte rubi suang in, na kongkhakte karbankul suang in, na kulh tengteng suang hoihte in ka bawl ding.
english: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

paite: "Na ta tengteng TOUPA chil in a-om ding ua; na tate lungmuanna thupitak ahi ding.
english: All your children will be taught by Yahweh, and your children’s peace will be great.

paite: Diktatna a kipsak in na om ding a, nuaisiahna a pan gamlapi ah na om ding, na lau kei ding hi; thil mulkimhuai a pan gamlapi ah na om ding a, ahon naih kei ding hi.
english: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.

paite: Ngai in, ahong kikhawm uh ahi thei, himahleh ka thu ahi kei ding; nang sual ding a kikhawm peuhmahte nang ziak in apuk ding uh.
english: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.

paite: "Ngai in, ke'n siksekmi pumzap anasepna ding vanzat sek zel mi ka siam a; kei mahmah in hihse ding in hihsemi ka siam ding hi.
english: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.

paite: Nang sualna ding avanzat sek himhim aphatuam kei ding; lei chih thubuai a nang hon lang siam louh na tangsak ding a, Huai TOUPA sikhate goutan ahi a, adiktatna uh ka kiang a kipan ahi," TOUPA'N achi.
english: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says Yahweh.
